captions.efficiency: Tag-and-probe efficiencies in data and simulation; error bars are statistical. Panels are ordered by increasing probe |eta| from left to right, then top to bottom: 0 < |eta| < 0.8, 0.8 < |eta| < 1.44, 1.44 < |eta| < 2.5.
captions.mass_fit_bin_00: Probe bin 0 < |eta| < 0.8, 5 < pT < 7 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.387; The resulting scale factor is 0.8431 +/- 0.0183.
captions.mass_fit_bin_01: Probe bin 0 < |eta| < 0.8, 7 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.317; The resulting scale factor is 0.8313 +/- 0.0141.
captions.mass_fit_bin_02: Probe bin 0.8 < |eta| < 1.44, 5 < pT < 7 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.118; The resulting scale factor is 0.9795 +/- 0.0325.
captions.mass_fit_bin_03: Probe bin 0.8 < |eta| < 1.44, 7 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.201; The resulting scale factor is 0.9146 +/- 0.0326.
captions.mass_fit_bin_04: Probe bin 1.44 < |eta| < 2.5, 5 < pT < 7 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.267; The scale-factor extraction in this bin is invalid and is not exported.
captions.mass_fit_bin_05: Probe bin 1.44 < |eta| < 2.5, 7 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=0.883; The resulting scale factor is 1.0327 +/- 0.0504.
captions.scale_factor: Data-to-simulation scale factors with total uncertainties; bins without a valid fit are omitted. The marker series correspond to the probe |eta| bins listed in the legend.
captions.scale_factor_heatmap: Two-dimensional scale-factor map; each cell shows the central value and total uncertainty.
